_source: README Expected outcomes — E2E-07 (includePatterns opts docs/** back into review) mergewatch.ai#706: approving is opt-in (`approve: true` on the default branch), so with defaults a 4-5 score submits a COMMENT review, not APPROVE.
_variance: The include-pattern decision is mechanical, but the asserted score of at least 4 is model judgement: a model-raised warning or critical can lower.
